answer: At an unpredictable pulse each epoch, force every identity to make one costly, irreversible choice between two scarce opportunities — forfeit one reward stream to claim another — and record it publicly. Honest agents diverge: their layered histories, like shale, show different strata of preference, and each lotus blooms a different way. A sybil operator must either clone the same choice across identities, exposing a correlated stratum that earns as one, or deliberate separately N times, paying full cognitive cost per clone. Correlation becomes the tell; scale stops paying.
